headline: A bicycle trailer that is always there when you need it.

problem.heading: The Problem
problem.body: Conventional trailers require storage, preparation and a separate attachment process. This makes them impractical for spontaneous everyday transport. There had to be a better way.

idea.heading: The Idea
idea.body:
I wanted to combine a rear carrier and a trailer in one structure.

So I started planning ...

gallery.caption: The main challenge was to figure out the folding mechanism.
The Frame is made of lightweight alluminium for easy transport.
Thorough limit testing to find the right balance between weight and stability.
Links der Gepäckträger Modus, rechts der Anhänger

result.heading: The Result
result.bodyBlack: The Result is an everyday product, that doubles as a gepäcktrager and a trailor while remaining light and visually restrained.
result.bodyMuted: When not in use, it follows the silhouette of the bicycle and remains visually unobtrusive. When deployed, the structure extends behind the bicycle and functions as a narrow single-wheel trailer.
